title: A cleaner text feed lands on the site
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: a new text feed, refreshed model routing, sturdier sharing metadata, and a little more visibility into real-world usage.

The site now has a Text Feed, with filtering that keeps it focused on direct entries rather than everything that arrived through a referrer. A small window into what people are making with text.

Mistral, QWQ, and DeepSeek Reasoning now run through Cloudflare-backed model integrations, keeping several useful text and reasoning options available behind the same simple endpoint.

Static Open Graph metadata replaces React Helmet for more dependable link previews, while pollinator-agent repository integrations were refreshed. The internet remains largely a network of bots passing metadata to other bots.
